tone.target: bright pop-rock clean with tight delay and light crunch
tone.profile: bright pop-rock clean with tight delay and light crunch
tone.summary: A bright Fender-style chain using a Clean Boost/Comp for articulation, followed by an AC30 TB or US Deluxe amp model, enhanced with Chorus and Digital Delay for pop-rock sparkle and rhythmic definition.

rig.name: No Doubt - Don't Speak - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Add sustain and even out dynamics for arpeggios.
Provide the occasional edge crunch without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used to simulate a light, breakup-style overdrive typical of pop-rock clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide the bright, articulate sound of a Fender-clean amp.
blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is chosen for its bright, chimey character, mimicking classic clean pop tones better than some other options.

blocks.purpose: Provide a balanced and open sound for the clean tone.
blocks.gap: While US 2x12 might be ideal, the UK Vintage 4x12 offers good overall clarity and is available in the catalog.

alternatives.reason: Closer cabinet match for Fender tones.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the high end and enhance clarity for arpeggios.
